m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You looking for a room for the night? Sorry, stranger, but the inn is closed. Oh, you're here for Helena. Odd one, isn't she?
Such a sad story she has. It's hardened her. But I can see in your eyes she never told it to you, so I best hold my tongue. What does she need?
Stormade? I'd love to give you some, but I'll need some help from you first. Information? No, I need something more specific.
We just had a Whirlyburly match against Port Aero and now our coach is... uh, coaching a spirited discussion between the fans inside.
That's why we're closed and why I'm out here. So if you want my Stormade, you'll need to settle them hooligans before they drink it all.
Saw you head off with Coach. Did you get your Stormade? Good. And, yes, I'll make sure the Legends get their electrolytes. I know my civic duty.
Oh, you want to give me Helena's information anyhow? The info she wanted you to trade for that Stormade? That's mighty kind of you.
WE'RE causing the Nightmare Myth Monsters? The Frog Prince and such, that's us?
Well, thanks for telling me. I'll spread the word, don't worry. 'Spose Helena told you to trade that info? She assumes the worst of everyone.
She didn't used to - I knew her when she lived in Nimbus - so much has changed since then. But that's her story to tell. You should get back.
You cheating mongrels! You only won 'cause the referee was from Port Aero.
Of course he was from Port Aero. You Velo City dunces can't count past four.
Sure we can. 1, 2, 3, 4, BUNCH OF FIVES!
Ay, sucker-punching, skullduggering Fangle chow. You Velo City types are always starting fights.
Not just starting 'em. Come on, son, show that fool - show everyone here - how we finish them.
Alright, alright, I'll settle down. I just wanted everyone to know Velo City's a town of cheating Ox spawn.
And I just wanted to clarify my point about Port Aero and the foolishness therein.
Guess we'll just have to agree to disagree.
Yes, indeedy. Come on, I'll buy you a muffin.
Let me tell you about Whirlyburly. It's the sport to end all sports, the ultimate game, the... really only entertainment we have in these parts.
All the Aero Dwarf towns - from Velo City to Wheatsville - have their own team. Even Port Aero. *spits* But ours has been lagging of late.
You showed some grit in that brawl. Tell you what, you help me whip my team into shape and I'll spare you some Stormade. You in? Good.
Here's the gist: you lead your three-man team to take control of spaces from other teams. Each space you control earns you points.
Each team also has a chest; if you can take that, you get even more points. Whoever gets the most points wins!
Simple, right? Good. Just remember, you don't need to win your first match. Just finishing a game helps me plenty. Sign up at the Kiosk.
You're back. Did you get the Stormade? Good. Take it over to my Hut to wake up the Justicar.
What... are... a Wizard? And you... you're dressed like a dwarf. No matter. Tell me, strange ones, do you know what happened to my squad?
They didn't make it, I'm afraid.
Then, whoever you are, you must help me strike back against the fiends responsible and rend their souls before their eyes.
The Frog Prince has been dealt with.
The Frog Prince was but a tool. I mean the Dark Cloud scum who sent it after us. I tracked them to the Oxen Range... but... they...
You're still weak, Justicar. Rest, recover. Come, Wizard, let us discuss matters.
Weren't you in a hurry? Go find Constance in Velo City.
